summary: Link Shelf is a local bookmark keeper. The user adds bookmarks with a title, a web address, and comma-separated tags, searches bookmarks by title or tag, and opens a bookmark in the default browser. Bookmarks are stored on the device and restored after restart.
targetUsers: People who collect web links and want a simple local place to keep and find them
goals: Keep a personal list of bookmarks with title, web address, and tags
Find a bookmark quickly by searching its title or tags
Open a saved bookmark in the default browser
Keep bookmarks on the device across restarts
nonGoals: Syncing bookmarks across devices or accounts

features.name: Bookmark list
features.userOutcome: The user sees all saved bookmarks with their titles, web addresses, and tags.
features.behavior: The main screen shows every saved bookmark as a row with its title, its web address, and its tags written as a comma-separated list. Rows are ordered newest first by creation time. When no bookmarks are saved, the list area shows the text "No bookmarks yet". The list loads the saved bookmarks when the app starts; if that load fails, the list area shows one message, "Bookmarks could not be loaded", and the rest of the screen stays usable.
features.failureOutcome: The saved bookmarks cannot be loaded at startup and the list area shows "Bookmarks could not be loaded".
acceptanceSignals: With two saved bookmarks, the list shows both rows ordered newest created first.
With no saved bookmarks, the list area shows "No bookmarks yet".
A bookmark read back from the store shows its saved title, web address, and tags.

features.name: Add bookmark
features.userOutcome: The user saves a new bookmark with a title, a web address, and tags.
features.behavior: A form asks for a title, a web address, and tags entered as comma-separated text. The title and the web address are required; the form rejects an empty title or an empty web address and keeps the entered values. The tags text is split on commas, each tag is trimmed of surrounding spaces, and empty tags are dropped. On save the bookmark is stored with the current moment as its creation time, the form closes, and the new bookmark appears at the top of the list. If the save fails, the form stays open with the entered values and shows "Bookmark could not be saved".
features.failureOutcome: The bookmark cannot be stored and the form stays open with the entered values and an error message.
acceptanceSignals: Saving a bookmark with title "Rust", web address "https://www.rust-lang.org", and tags "lang, docs" stores one record whose tags are ["lang", "docs"].
Submitting an empty title or an empty web address keeps the form open and stores no record.
A failed save leaves the previously stored bookmarks unchanged.

features.name: Search bookmarks
features.userOutcome: The user narrows the bookmark list to bookmarks whose title or tags match the search text.
features.trigger: The user types in the search field.
features.behavior: A search field above the list filters the shown bookmarks as the user types. A bookmark matches when the search text, compared case-insensitively, appears in its title or in any one of its tags. The search field starts empty, which shows all bookmarks. Clearing the search field returns to showing all bookmarks. When no bookmark matches, the list area shows "No bookmarks match your search".
features.failureOutcome: The search text cannot be applied and the list keeps showing the previous results.
acceptanceSignals: Typing "rust" shows only bookmarks whose title or a tag contains "rust" in any letter case.
Clearing the search field shows all saved bookmarks again.
A search with no match shows "No bookmarks match your search".

features.name: Open bookmark
features.userOutcome: The user opens a saved bookmark's web address in the default browser.
features.trigger: The user chooses Open on a bookmark row.
features.behavior: Each bookmark row has an Open button. Choosing it asks the operating system to open the bookmark's web address in the default browser. If the request is rejected, the row shows "Could not open this bookmark" and the bookmark stays unchanged.
features.failureOutcome: The operating system rejects the request to open the web address and the row shows an error.
acceptanceSignals: Choosing Open on a row makes one request to open that row's exact web address with the default browser.
A rejected open request leaves the stored bookmark unchanged and shows "Could not open this bookmark" in that row.

dataObjects.name: Bookmarks
dataObjects.purpose: The saved bookmarks, each with a title, a web address, and tags.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user removes the app's data.

qualityRequirements: Search results update as the user types without a separate submit action.
productConstraints: Bookmarks are stored only on the device; no account or network service is used.
The app opens web addresses through the operating system's default browser.
